OPPProvenance.description:
Provenance for exactly one physical value.

This table is the mechanism by which the never-invent-data law is enforced
in the IDL rather than in prose: no physical quantity in an $OPP can be
expressed without one of these attached, so a value with no admissible
source cannot be encoded at all. Unknown values are ABSENT. They are never
zero, never a placeholder, and never carried forward from a different
object.

SOURCE.description:
Publisher of the value, named as the publisher names itself — a space
agency's object database, a public satellite catalogue, a third-party
satellite reference site, or the operator itself.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the record this value was read from, such
as that database's object id. Verbatim, never normalized.

SOURCE_URL.description: Deep link to the exact source record when the source publishes one.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) of the
instant the value describes: the epoch at which the property held. A
design or as-built value that does not change over time omits EPOCH.

RETRIEVED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
this record retrieved the value from SOURCE.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: The source's own revision, edition or publication marker, verbatim.

LICENSE.description: Terms under which SOURCE permits redistribution of the value, verbatim.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution string the source requires be displayed with the value.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact source
payload bytes the value was parsed from.

NOTES.description: Free text qualifying the value, such as the source's own caveat.

OPPQuantity.description:
One scalar physical quantity, its unit and its own provenance.

PROVENANCE is required: an OPPQuantity that exists names where it came from.
Presence of the table is the signal that a value exists, so VALUE zero is a
real zero (0 dBsm is 1 m2) and an unknown quantity omits the whole table.

UNITS.description:
Unit symbol verbatim, never silently converted: "kg", "m", "m2", "m2/kg",
"kg/m2", "dBsm", "W", "mag". A converted value states the unit it was
converted to and records the conversion in PROVENANCE.NOTES with
PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

SIGMA.description:
1-sigma uncertainty in UNITS. Zero means the source stated no uncertainty;
a genuine stated sigma is never exactly zero.

OPPRadarCrossSection.description:
Radar cross-section as reported for one band, polarization and aspect
convention. Radar cross-section is band- and aspect-dependent, so an $OPP
carries a list of these and never a single scalar. A source publishing
minimum, average and maximum cross-sections becomes three entries with
ASPECT MINIMUM, AVERAGE and MAXIMUM sharing one SOURCE.

BAND.description:
Radar band designation verbatim from the source: "UHF", "L", "S", "C",
"X", "Ku". Empty when the source states no band.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Centre frequency [megahertz] when the source states one. Zero means
unstated.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization verbatim from the source: "HH", "VV", "HV", "RCRC". Empty
when the source states none.

CROSS_SECTION.description:
The cross-section itself. UNITS is "m2" or "dBsm" as the source published
it; the two are never mixed within one entry and never silently converted.

SIZE_CLASS.description:
Size bucket verbatim when a source publishes a bucket instead of a number,
such as a public catalogue's "SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE". A bucket is never
turned into a number.

SENSOR.description: Sensor or facility that produced the measurement, when stated.

OPPMass.description:
Mass breakdown. Each component is independently sourced; a wet mass and a
dry mass may legitimately come from different publishers and epochs.

WET.description: Mass with propellant, at the stated epoch [kg].

LAUNCH.description: Mass at separation from the launch vehicle [kg].

PROPELLANT.description: Propellant mass at the stated epoch [kg].

PAYLOAD.description: Payload mass carried by the bus [kg].

CURRENT.description: Best current estimate of mass at the record's epoch [kg].

OPPDimensions.description:
Physical envelope. Every extent is a sourced quantity. Extents measured off
3D-asset geometry carry PROVENANCE.METHOD MODEL_DERIVED and describe the
model, not the flight article.

BODY_X.description: Extents along the object's own body axes [m].

HEIGHT.description: Envelope terms as an object database publishes them [m].

SHAPE.description:
Gross geometric shape verbatim from the source, such as a shape string
of the form "Box + 1 Pan" or "Cyl". Never parsed into geometry.

SHAPE_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of SHAPE. Present whenever SHAPE is nonempty.

OPPAreas.description: Projected areas and the ratios derived from them.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_AVERAGE.description: Average projected cross-sectional area over all aspects [m2].

AREA_TO_MASS_RATIO.description:
Area-to-mass ratio [m2/kg], only when a source publishes one directly or
the publisher derives it with PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

OPPSurface.description:
One exterior surface of the object: what it is made of, how large it is and
how it interacts with light.

$PNL carries the articulated panel model used for solar-radiation-pressure
propagation; an $OPP surface is the sourced material inventory. When both
exist, PANEL_ID joins this surface to its $PNL panel. GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME and
GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX join it to the exact glTF material in the asset variant
named by OPP.ASSET.

ID.description: Stable identifier for this surface within the record.

MATERIAL.description:
Material name verbatim from the source, in whatever designation the
source uses: a multi-layer-insulation film, a photovoltaic cell
chemistry, an alloy temper designation. Empty when unstated.

COUNT.description:
How many identical surfaces this entry represents, such as two solar-array
wings.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of MATERIAL, MATERIAL_CLASS, KIND and COUNT. Every dimensioned
field below carries its own.

AREA.description: Area of one surface, not of COUNT surfaces [m2].

SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected specularly, dimensionless.

DIFFUSE_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected diffusely, dimensionless.

PANEL_ID.description:
Join key to the $PNL panel representing this surface; holds that record's
PNLPanel.PANEL_ID verbatim. Empty when no $PNL panel exists.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
Name of the glTF material that renders this surface, verbatim, in the
variant named by OPP.ASSET.VARIANT_ID. Empty when the surface is not
represented in the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX.description:
Zero-based index into the glTF materials array of that same variant.
Negative one means no glTF material corresponds to this surface.

OPPAssetRef.description:
Binding to the exact 3D asset bytes this record accompanies.

Every field is copied verbatim from the $VAM that governs the asset, so an
$OPP is valid for exactly one reviewed variant. Different bytes are a
different asset: mint a new $OPP and set SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID rather than
repointing an existing one.

VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact $VAM bytes.

VARIANT_ID.description: $VAMVariant.ID verbatim: the specific glTF or GLB this record describes.

ASSET_SHA256.description:
$VAMVariant.BYTE_SHA256 verbatim: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
encoding SHA-256 of the exact asset file bytes.

GEOMETRY_MATCHES_PHYSICAL.description:
True only when the asset geometry was authored or rescaled to the physical
dimensions in this record. False, the default, means the asset is
representative and its geometry is not a source of physical dimensions.

METERS_PER_ASSET_UNIT.description:
Metres per asset unit for the named variant. Restates
$VAMTransform.METERS_PER_SOURCE_UNIT for consumers that read only $OPP.

OPP.description:
Object Physical Properties - the sourced physical description of one space
object and, when one exists, of the exact 3D asset that represents it.

Division of labour with the neighbouring standards. $CAT is catalogue
identity and orbit, and its RCS, SIZE and MASS scalars are unattributed
convenience fields carried from the catalogue publisher. $BUS is the bus
DESIGN, shared by every object built on it. $VAM is the asset manifest: the
bytes, the licence, the review and the geometry metrics. $PNL is the
articulated panel model consumed by solar-radiation-pressure propagation.
$OPP is the per-object physical truth in which EVERY value names its own
source, epoch and method. $OPP never restates orbital elements and never
duplicates bus-design values; a per-object value that came from the bus
design is stated here with METHOD INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY so a consumer can see
that it is an approximation.

Joins. NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID join to $CAT. BUS_ID joins to $BUS.
ASSET joins to the exact reviewed $VAM variant. ENTITY_ID is the stable
non-catalogue key shared with $VAM for objects that have no catalogue entry.

Never-invent law, enforced by the shape rather than by prose: a physical
quantity exists only as an OPPQuantity and OPPQuantity.PROVENANCE is
required, so there is no encoding for a mass, dimension, area or
cross-section that does not name where it came from. Unknown values are
absent. A consumer that finds a field missing has learned that no admissible
source published it.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 record-format version, not a content revision.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: $CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID verbatim. Zero when the object has no catalogue number.

OBJECT_NAME.description: $CAT.OBJECT_NAME verbatim, for display only. Never a join key.

ENTITY_ID.description:
Stable non-catalogue entity key, such as an asset catalogue entity path.
MUST equal ASSET.ENTITY_ID when ASSET is present.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the $BUS record describing this object's bus design; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. Empty when the bus is unknown or has no
$BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY.description:
Bus or platform family name verbatim from BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.SOURCE,
for objects whose family is known but has no $BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of BUS_FAMILY. Present whenever BUS_FAMILY is nonempty.

MANUFACTURER.description: Manufacturer or prime contractor as stated by MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.

MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of MANUFACTURER. Present whenever MANUFACTURER is nonempty.

RADAR_CROSS_SECTIONS.description:
One entry per band, polarization and aspect the sources publish. Empty
means no source published a radar cross-section for this object.

VISUAL_MAGNITUDE.description:
Visual magnitude, UNITS "mag", with the observing conditions in
PROVENANCE.NOTES.

ASSET.description:
Binding to the exact reviewed 3D asset this record accompanies. Absent for
an object with no asset; the physical values remain valid without it.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted while building this record, including sources that
yielded no value. Lets a consumer distinguish "not looked for" from
"looked for and not published".

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
the record was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
the record was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded $OPP bytes.

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

SCVAzElMaskPoint.description:
One point of an azimuth/elevation mask: the lowest elevation at which the
sensor sees at that azimuth (a terrain or structure horizon). The mask is the
polyline through its points ordered by AZIMUTH_DEG, wrapping from the last
point to the first across 360 degrees, linearly interpolated in azimuth.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth, degrees clockwise from north, in [0, 360).

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum visible elevation at AZIMUTH_DEG, degrees above the local horizontal.

SCVSensorShapeContract.description:
The field-of-view shape of one sensor. $SCV carries it in SCVSensor; $SNR
carries the same table as the sensor definition's FIELD_OF_VIEW, so a
definition and an analysis request never describe a shape in two types.

AZ_EL_MASK.description:
Azimuth/elevation mask of a ground sensor, empty when the sensor has none.
Clips the shape: a direction below the mask is outside the field of view.

SNRSpectralBand.description:
One spectral band of a sensor, in Hz. Hz is the unit for every band, optical
included; a consumer that wants wavelength converts (lambda = c / f).
Positive quantities use the default 0 for "not stated".

NAME.description: The band as its source names it: "UHF", "X-band", "VNIR", "Green".

DESIGNATION.description:
The designation exactly as the source states it ("UHF", "X", "Ka", "SWIR").
Verbatim, never derived from the frequencies. RF designations use $RFB
rfBandDesignation spellings. Absent when the source states none.

PROVENANCE.description: Where this band was read, when it differs from the record's PROVENANCE.

SNRMounting.description:
How the sensor sits on its platform and where it points. Angles are degrees
and signed, so an unset angle is NaN (absent), never 0.

BORESIGHT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Boresight azimuth in FRAME. NaN = not stated.

BORESIGHT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Boresight elevation in FRAME. NaN = not stated.

ROLL_DEG.description: Roll about the boresight. NaN = not stated.

SCAN_AZIMUTH_RATE_DEG_S.description: Azimuth scan rate, degrees per second, for POINTING SCAN. NaN = not stated.

SCAN_ELEVATION_RATE_DEG_S.description: Elevation scan rate, degrees per second, for POINTING SCAN. NaN = not stated.

AZIMUTH_LIMIT_MIN_DEG.description:
Field-of-regard limits in FRAME, degrees. NaN = no limit stated.
ELEVATION_LIMIT_MIN_DEG is the minimum elevation a ground sensor operates at.

PROVENANCE.description: Where the mounting was read, when it differs from the record's PROVENANCE.

SNRRfParameters.description:
Radio-frequency parameters. Positive quantities use 0 for "not stated";
ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI is signed and uses NaN.

ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Antenna gain, dBi. NaN = not stated.

PROVENANCE.description: Where these values were read, when it differs from the record's PROVENANCE.

SNROpticalParameters.description:
Optical parameters. Every quantity is positive except LIMITING_MAGNITUDE,
which is signed and uses NaN for "not stated"; 0 means "not stated" elsewhere.

IFOV_RAD.description: Instantaneous field of view of one detector element, radians.

GSD_M.description:
Ground sample distance, m, at the nadir and nominal altitude the source
states (qualifiers go in PROVENANCE.NOTES).

LIMITING_MAGNITUDE.description: Limiting visual magnitude. NaN = not stated.

DETECTOR.description: Detector as the source names it ("CCD", "HgCdTe", "sCMOS").

PROVENANCE.description: Where these values were read, when it differs from the record's PROVENANCE.

SNR.description:
Sensor definition: the sensor a platform carries. One record is one sensor.

UNKNOWN IS ABSENT. A positive quantity unset is 0, a signed quantity unset
is NaN, an unset enum is its UNSPECIFIED (or UNKNOWN) member, an unset
string, table or vector is absent. A value is never invented, never zero as a
placeholder, never copied from another sensor. Hz is the only frequency unit.
Display colors are viewer preferences and never travel in this record.

Platform: NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID join to $CAT, SITE_ID to $SIT.ID,
SENSOR_ID to $SEN.ID. A sensor not attached to a platform has none of them.

SENSOR_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sensor. $SEN.ID of the same sensor.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: $CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID of the spacecraft that carries the sensor. 0 = none.

OBJECT_ID.description: $CAT.OBJECT_ID (COSPAR designator) of the spacecraft that carries it.

SITE_ID.description: $SIT.ID of the ground site the sensor is at.

ENTITY_ID.description:
Stable non-catalogue entity key of the platform, for a platform with neither
a catalogue number nor a $SIT.

SPECTRAL_BANDS.description:
Spectral bands in Hz. One list serves a radar, a multispectral imager and
a passive RF receiver. Empty = none stated.

FIELD_OF_VIEW.description: Field-of-view shape: the same table $SCV analyses use.

FIELD_OF_VIEW_PROVENANCE.description: Where FIELD_OF_VIEW was read, when it differs from PROVENANCE.

PROVENANCE.description:
Where the values of this record were read. A published real-world sensor
carries SOURCE, RETRIEVED_AT, METHOD and LICENSE; a user-defined sensor
carries METHOD USER_DEFINED. A section's own PROVENANCE supersedes this one
for that section.
